items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: The name 'Garden King' appears only in the interviewer's question ('[INTERVIEWER] Garden King. Why did you...'). ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: That was in... music for them. They had no regular band that he could play in, but any odd job that he could get, he did. He did. Dorns loved music. Dorns loved music and sound. I say something, he says I'm interfering. But I'm just trying to enlighten you on his music life. As a career, he did not accept that as a career. He doesn't like…
